name: Femto W
summary: Femto W is a wide-field iToF depth and RGB camera with integrated depth computing and a six-axis IMU. It provides close-range depth and 4K color streams through USB-C for robotic perception and other 3D vision applications. Marketing ended in September 2025.

In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of technological

W . We hope this information will serve as a reference for your future product planning and
development.
Orbbec Inc.
February 20, 2025
